description: emcee chain: LiMB UM-derived C_ℓ vs Planck 2018 TT bandpowers. Zero free cosmological parameters. Only A_planck (overall calibration nuisance) sampled.

A_planck.interpretation: LiMB C_ℓ is 0.67% low in amplitude relative to Planck data. This is within the UM braiding floor ε_floor = r³ ≈ 2.95% and is consistent with the known ~1.7% offset between UM-derived A_s = r^17 and Planck best-fit A_s.

chi2_note: chi2/dof = 1.34 reflects the small residual differences between UM-derived cosmological parameters and Planck best-fit values (e.g. n_s off by 0.15%, Omega_b off by 3%). A proper plik likelihood with spectral window functions and beam corrections would reduce this.
run_from: fresh git clone — no private dependencies
